fullPassage:
Dear Dog Owners,
My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for resting and staying cool. We hope you will have a wonderful time with your dogs in this newly opened park.
Regards,
Lily Paxton, Pet Program Coordinator

questions.passage: Dear Dog Owners, My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an (A)[enjoyable / unpleasant] experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have (B)[separate / combined] spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for resting and staying cool. We hope you will have a (C)[wonderful / terrible] time with your dogs in this newly opened park. Regards, Lily Paxton, Pet Program Coordinator
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 공원은 반려견과 주인 모두에게 즐거운 경험을 제공하도록 설계되었습니다. 소형견과 대형견을 위한 별도의 공간이 있습니다. 여러분이 반려견과 함께 멋진 시간을 보내시길 바랍니다.
det.analysis:
① unpleasant(불쾌한)은 enjoyable의 반의어
② enjoyable — separate — wonderful: 원문 그대로 ←정답
③ combined(통합된)는 separate의 반의어
④ terrible(끔찍한)은 wonderful의 반의어

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 여러분은 __________을(를) 위한 많은 벤치와 공간도 발견하실 것입니다.
det.analysis:
① resting and staying cool: 벤치와 공간의 용도로 적절 ←정답
② run, jump, and play: 본문 표현이지만 이것은 잔디밭 활동이지 벤치 용도 아님
③ ensure safety: 본문 표현이지만 공간 분리 목적이지 벤치 용도 아님
④ make the community: 본문 표현이지만 공원 전체 목적이지 벤치 용도 아님
det.tip: benches(벤치) + areas(공간) → resting(휴식) + staying cool(시원하게 지내기)
